title: Lifting a derived complex for a projective class
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, $I\subseteq R$ an ideal, $\mathcal P$ a class of $R$-modules, $K\in D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and $E^\bullet$ a complex of $R/I$-modules representing $K\otimes_R^{\mathbf L}R/I$ in $D(R/I)$. Assume: (1) every member of $\mathcal P$ is projective; (2) $P_1\in\mathcal P$ and $P_1\oplus P_2\in\mathcal P$ if and only if $P_1,P_2\in\mathcal P$; (3) every map $f:P_1\to P_2$ with $P_1,P_2\in\mathcal P$ that is surjective modulo $I$ is surjective; (4) $E^\bullet$ is bounded above and each $E^i$ is isomorphic to $P/IP$ for some $P\in\mathcal P$; and (5) $K$ is represented by a bounded-above complex with terms in $\mathcal P$. Then $K$ is represented by a bounded-above complex $P^\bullet$ with terms in $\mathcal P$ whose termwise quotient $P^\bullet/IP^\bullet$ is isomorphic to $E^\bullet$ as a complex.

proof.text: Choose K0 and its supplied derived reduction isomorphism from hK. Construct an acyclic cone C and the continuation producing a right-exact cokernel diagram from any acyclic lift.
Derive closure under summands from the iff class condition. Apply the existing acyclic lifting theorem to C, and feed the resulting A and its reduction isomorphism into the cone continuation.

In each degree use the reduced cokernel identification with E[1] and its class lift to apply the reduced splitting theorem. This gives a short exact sequence of complexes and class membership for every cokernel term.

The acyclic middle complex is zero in the derived category, since zero -> A is a quasi-isomorphism. The connecting arrow of the short-exact-sequence triangle is therefore invertible. Shift the cokernel by -1, use commutation of Q with shifts and cancellation of shifts to identify its image with K. Its bound shifts by one and its terms remain in the class. Apply commutation of scalar extension with shifts and cancel E[1][-1] to obtain the required complex isomorphism.

lean.statement: theorem complex_lift_class_projective (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (Pclass : Set (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I))] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (E : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)) ℤ) (hproj : ∀ P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P ∈ Pclass → Projective P) (hclosed : ∀ P₁ P₂ P₁₂ : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, Nonempty (P₁₂ ≅ ModuleCat.of R (P₁ × P₂)) → (P₁ ∈ Pclass ∧ P₁₂ ∈ Pclass ↔ P₁ ∈ Pclass ∧ P₂ ∈ Pclass)) (hsurj : ∀ (P₁ P₂ : ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (f : P₁ ⟶ P₂), P₁ ∈ Pclass → P₂ ∈ Pclass → Function.Surjective ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).map f) → Function.Surjective f) (hEbound : ∃ b : ℤ, E.IsStrictlyLE b) (hEterms : ∀ i : ℤ, ∃ P : ModuleCat.{max u v} R, P ∈ Pclass ∧ Nonempty (E.X i ≅ (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).obj P)) (hK : ∃ K₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ, (∃ b : ℤ, K₀.IsStrictlyLE b) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, K₀.X i ∈ Pclass) ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K₀ ≅ K) ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K₀) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj E)) : ∃ P₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ, (∃ b : ℤ, P₀.IsStrictlyLE b) ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, P₀.X i ∈ Pclass) ∧ Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P₀ ≅ K) ∧ Nonempty (((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj P₀ ≅ E)
